answer: Tie reward to a periodic random liveness pulse each agent answers in a tight window with a signature from one non-transferable key bound to a scarce external anchor; standing accretes slowly like ivory carved ring by ring across many peer-audited epochs. A fleet forked from one wallet cannot forge distinct cross-cluster signatures, so every clone shares one root or misses its own pulse: the farm funds a distinct anchor per head (cost linear) while an honest node pays once.
